name: pairs
task: (d) two listing titles -> same | variant | different
recordedFrom: dev DB listings (Delsey.ca EN pages vs the same store's /fr/ pages, indexed 2026-10-08) + CLD/Amazon.ca/Samsonite.ca/U.N./Luggage City titles in the index

labelRules.same: the same product (and colour where both name one); Delsey: identical 11-digit store code
labelRules.variant: same product, different colour; Delsey: same 9-digit model, different 2-digit colour code
labelRules.different: anything else: size, inches, version, edition, line words that tell products apart
labelRules.stores: the store each title came from (both pipelines get it; production fills a brand-direct store brand from it)

knownGaps: Chatelet Air 1.0 is not in our index, so the 2.0 vs 1.0 trap is represented by SKY MAX 2.0 vs 3.0
Delsey lists three different 2-piece sets with identical titles; title-only pairs can't tell them apart, so they are left out (they need the SKU)
